'''Jakal''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] hired by the Qreph brothers to scam [[Omad Kaeg]] of his share in the mining cooperative he was in in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. They did this by manipulating him into a rigged [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game that saw to Kaeg owing them a large marker that he had no choice but to pay with his share.

Jakal and his associate, [[Scarn]], along with their assisting [[Nargon]], [[Qizak]], confronted Kaeg about his gambling marker in the [[Red Ronto]] aboard [[Brink Station]]. However, Kaeg was in a meeting with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]], and the Solos managed to determine the Mandalorians' scam on Kaeg. This resulted in a violent confrontation that saw to Scarn's death while Jakal was seriously wounded, resulting in the failure of their mission as the Solos and Kaeg escaped.
